title: Design tokens: the short version
subtitle: Summary with key points
tldr: Design tokens are named design decisions. You store them once and use them everywhere.

items.title: One source of truth
items.text: Colors, spacing and type live in one place. Code and design both read from it.

items.title: Names carry meaning
items.text: Use color-text-muted, not gray-500. The name says what it is for.

items.title: Two layers work best
items.text: Raw values first (primitives). Meaning on top (semantic tokens).

items.title: Themes get cheap
items.text: Dark mode swaps the semantic layer. Components stay the same.

callout.title: Start small
callout.text: Begin with color, spacing, radius and type. Add more when you feel the pain.
